web.title: Vercel WAF vs Cloudflare WAF | Vercel Knowledge Base
web.description:
Cloudflare WAF and Vercel WAF sit on opposite sides of that choice. Cloudflare runs as a reverse proxy at its own edge, in front of any origin you point it at.

## [Copy link to heading](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/vercel-waf-vs-cloudflare-waf#how-vercel-waf-and-cloudflare-waf-compare) How Vercel WAF and Cloudflare WAF compare
### [Copy link to heading](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/vercel-waf-vs-cloudflare-waf#ddos-and-platform-protection) DDoS and platform protection
| Concern | Vercel WAF | Cloudflare WAF |
|-|-|-|
| L3/L4 DDoS | Unmetered, always on, at Vercel's edge | Unmetered, always on, at Cloudflare's network edge |
| Rate limiting | All plans. Fixed Window (all), Token Bucket (Enterprise). SDK for application-level limits. | All plans. Fixed and sliding window. Counting expressions. |

## [Copy link to heading](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/vercel-waf-vs-cloudflare-waf#what-they-cost) What they cost
| Feature | Vercel WAF | Cloudflare WAF |
|-|-|-|
| Custom rules | All plans | All plans (Free: 5 rules; Pro: 20; Business: 100; Enterprise: 1,000) |
| OWASP managed ruleset | Enterprise | Pro ($20/mo) and above |
| Rate limiting | All plans, first 1M requests are included, $0.50 per million after | All plans, free plan includes one rule |
| L3/L4/L7 DDoS | Unmetered, all plans | Unmetered, all plans |

## [Copy link to heading](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/vercel-waf-vs-cloudflare-waf#should-you-run-both) Should you run both?
You pay Cloudflare for the proxy layer and Vercel for the underlying delivery and compute, for traffic that either could serve alone.

In that case, Cloudflare WAF makes sense in front of non-Vercel origins or alongside Vercel for specific zones that need those features.

## [Copy link to heading](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/vercel-waf-vs-cloudflare-waf#when-to-choose-vercel-waf-or-cloudflare-waf) When to choose Vercel WAF or Cloudflare WAF
| If your workload looks like... | Choose | Why |
|-|-|-|
| Application already on Vercel, need L7 rules, IP blocking, geo, rate limiting | Vercel WAF | Included in plan, framework-aware rules, sub-300ms propagation, no second CDN |
| Protecting origins that don't run on Vercel | Cloudflare WAF | Reverse-proxy model works in front of any origin |

web.title: Add Rate Limiting with Vercel | Vercel Knowledge Base
web.description:
[Skip to content](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/add-rate-limiting-vercel#geist-skip-nav)

This guide is a comprehensive walkthrough to handle rate limiting using the Vercel [Web Application Firewall](https://vercel.com/docs/security/vercel-waf) (WAF). We will discuss the necessity of rate limiting, understanding Vercel and its features like Vercel WAF and review a [resource](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/add-rate-limiting-vercel#how-to-implement-rate-limiting) on implementing rate limiting with Vercel WAF.

## [Copy link to heading](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/add-rate-limiting-vercel#how-to-implement-rate-limiting) How to Implement Rate Limiting
With Vercel WAF, you can configure specific rules to log, deny, challenge, bypass, or rate limit traffic to your site. When you apply the configuration, it takes effect immediately and does not require re-deployment.

1. Add a rate limiting custom rule to your Vercel project with the [Rate Limit API Requests Firewall Rule](https://vercel.com/templates/other/rate-limit-api-requests-firewall-rule) template or the [Get Started](https://vercel.com/docs/security/vercel-waf/rate-limiting#get-started) documentation
3. Set the Then action to Rate Limit and follow the remaining steps from the [Get started](https://vercel.com/docs/security/vercel-waf/rate-limiting#get-started) documentation

### [Copy link to heading](https://vercel.com/kb/guide/add-rate-limiting-vercel#rate-limit-in-code-with-@vercel/firewall) Rate limit in code with`@vercel/firewall`
Use the `@vercel/firewall` package if you need rate limiting:

- Based on application-level conditions, such as a user ID, organization, or custom header that not available in the dashboard
- Based on requests in your backend

First, create a WAF rule in the Vercel dashboard with `@vercel/firewall` as the condition and a rate limit ID.

Then use that ID in your code:

rate-limit.ts

See the [Rate Limiting SDK documentation](https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-firewall/vercel-waf/rate-limiting-sdk) for full setup instructions.

- [Web Application Firewall](https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-firewall/vercel-waf)

web.title: Vercel Firewall vs. Cloudflare - Protecting Your Modern Web App
web.description:
### Vercel Firewall: Integrated Protection for the Vercel Ecosystem
- **DDoS Mitigation:** Offers built-in protection against volumetric DDoS attacks, absorbing malicious traffic at the edge.

**Cons:**

### Feature Comparison
| Feature | Vercel Firewall | Cloudflare Security Suite |
|-|-|-|
| **WAF Rules** | Managed (OWASP) | Managed (CF, OWASP), Custom Rules |
| **WAF Customization** | Limited | Extensive |
| **DDoS Mitigation** | Built-in, Less Configurable | Advanced, Highly Configurable |
| **Rate Limiting** | Basic/Emerging | Advanced, Highly Configurable |

### Conclusion
Both Vercel Firewall and Cloudflare offer valuable security protections. Cloudflare delivers a feature-rich, platform-agnostic security powerhouse known for its robust DDoS protection and highly customizable WAF.
